title: Using network analysis for the prediction of treatment dropout in patients with mood and anxiety disorders: A methodological proof-of-concept study
limitations: - Small sample size; - High number of potential predictor variables (small n large p); - Unequal division of patients into completers and dropouts; - Limited number of items for assessing treatment expectations.
